description: HIGH TECH INNOVATION, SPACE BASED INNOVATION
summary: The Neutron Sky" is a space-based solar power concept by independent researcher M. A. Nilesh and this project is from IEEE New York research paper Initial stage and designed to provide sustainable, 24/7 clean energy. The architecture features a constellation of modular satellites equipped with origami-style deployable solar arrays that capture sunlight above Earth's atmosphere. Collected energy is stored and wirelessly beamed down to ground receiving stations using microwaves. To ensure reliability, the system incorporates AI-based health monitoring and a digital twin for autonomous fault detection. These design targets aim to eliminate fossil fuel reliance and reduce terrestrial environmental impacts.
